transcript.text: What was the total net revenue for the anchor region in calendar year 2025? Compute net revenue as amount minus discount over completed orders only, amounts are integer US cents (divide by 100), in USD rounded to the nearest cent.

args.intent: anchor region definition net revenue calculation
anchor region North orders completed status net revenue calculation rules

transcript.text: Now compute net revenue for North region, calendar year 2025, completed orders, joining orders to customers.

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_cents, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'North'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
SELECT MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date), COUNT(*) FROM memory.bench.legacy_orders
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory.bench.legacy_orders l JOIN memory.bench.orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
